text: The plumbing planner checks its plan against the tests that pin what it keeps (#518). Before naming files, it looks for the existing tests and fakes that check the behavior a change alters, such as a command line or flags a fake validates, and names every existing test file the change needs. An acceptance test's expectations about kept behavior must agree with the existing tests that pin it; a plan that means to change pinned behavior says so in its summary and names those tests. Two ratified plans on 2026-11-03 failed only at build time for want of this: #497's left out a fake Docker that rejected a new option, and #514's acceptance test contradicted the label behavior an existing test pins.
